## 1. Data integrity

- All figures below come from the verified snapshot or the get_stock_data / get_indicators outputs. The 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA, RSI, Bollinger middle and lower bands, MACD and ATR all match the verified snapshot. I found no discrepancies.
- Three values come only from the snapshot, because I did not pull them separately: the Bollinger upper band (159.08), the MACD signal (-5.62) and the MACD histogram (-3.18).
- The 200 SMA comes from the indicator vendor. My price pull has only 127 rows, so I cannot recompute it independently.
- The 2026-11-16 bar (close 103.03, volume 20,978,725) is the latest row on the analysis date. I can't confirm it is a completed session, so treat its close and volume as provisional.
- The tools gave no news, bitcoin or fundamental data. I make no claims about what is driving the moves.

## 2. Indicators selected (8) and why

| Indicator | Role |
|---|---|
| close_10_ema | Short-term momentum and the first "reclaim" level for any bounce |
| close_50_sma | Medium-term trend and overhead reference |
| close_200_sma | Long-term trend benchmark |
| macd | Trend momentum (signal and histogram taken from the snapshot) |
| rsi | Overbought/oversold read |
| boll | 20-day mean, the reversion target |
| boll_lb | Extension / oversold boundary (upper band from snapshot) |
| atr | Volatility for stops and sizing |

I left out vwma to avoid redundancy with the moving averages. I read volume directly from the OHLCV data instead.

## 3. Price structure

**Verified latest bar (2026-11-16):** open 103.74, high 105.79, low 101.70, close 103.03.

**Round trip.** The closing low of the period was 82.31 on 2026-06-26. The stock then built a range of roughly 91–102 on closes through mid-August. It broke out on 2026-08-19 (close 104.25 vs 92.52 the day before, on 49.2M volume). It peaked at a close of 168.50 on 2026-09-21.

From that peak to 103.03 is a 65.47-point decline. That is about 86% of the 76-point advance from the 08-18 close (92.52) to the 09-21 close, measured on closes.

**Downtrend structure on closes:**
- Lower highs: 168.50 (09-21), 164.55 (10-06), 153.48 (10-21), 142.54 (11-04).
- Lower lows: 136.02 (10-19), 130.51 (10-30), 103.03 (11-16).

**Recent acceleration.** Closes over the last six sessions:

| Date | Close |
|---|---:|
| 11-09 | 125.59 |
| 11-10 | 121.07 |
| 11-11 | 122.35 |
| 11-12 | 114.41 |
| 11-13 | 111.62 |
| 11-16 | 103.03 |

Today's 8.59-point drop (about 7.7%) is the largest in that run. The 11-16 high of 105.79 sits below the lower Bollinger band, so the whole session traded under it.

**Volume.** Today's 20.98M is the highest since 11-05 (26.04M), subject to the provisional-bar caveat. Heavier volume came on earlier down legs: 10-16 (31.97M), 10-30 (34.01M) and 11-05 (26.04M).

## 4. Trend: moving averages

- **Ordering of levels, bottom to top:** price 103.03 < 10 EMA 120.54 < 200 SMA 132.55 ≈ Bollinger middle 132.59 < 50 SMA 142.47. Every average is overhead.
- **10 EMA** has fallen from 147.66 (10-21) to 120.54, and it dropped 3.9 points in just the last session (124.43 on 11-13). It crossed below the 50 SMA on 10-30 (141.87 vs 143.67), the same day the close fell to 130.51 on 34M volume. Price is now 17.5 points below it.
- **50 SMA** peaked at 144.60 on 11-05 and has rolled over to 142.47.
- **200 SMA** has declined steadily from 135.53 (10-19) to 132.55.
- **Price vs 200 SMA:** closes have been below it every session since 11-05 (129.30 vs 133.90 that day). Earlier closes below it were 10-30 and 11-02.
- **50/200 relationship:** the 50 SMA is still above the 200 SMA by about 9.9 points (142.47 vs 132.55), so there is no death cross in the data. The gap has narrowed from about 10.7 on 11-05, and with price at 103.03 the 50 SMA has more room to fall. That "golden-cross-style" configuration is lagging and is not currently a bullish signal.
- **Confluence:** the 200 SMA (132.55) and the Bollinger middle (132.59) sit almost on top of each other. That is the main overhead reference, about 29.5 points above price.

## 5. Momentum: MACD and RSI

- **MACD** is -8.80 against a signal of -5.62, so the histogram is -3.18. The MACD line crossed below zero between 10-23 (+0.61) and 10-26 (-0.05). It has fallen almost every session since, from -3.16 on 11-05 to -8.80 now. The negative histogram shows bearish momentum is still building, not fading.
- **RSI** is 28.73, below 30 for the first time in this 30-day window. It was 54.51 on 10-21 and 32.57 on 11-13.
- **No bullish divergence is visible.** RSI is making new lows alongside price (within this window). In a strong trend RSI can stay oversold, so a sub-30 reading is a warning about stretch, not a buy signal.

## 6. Volatility: Bollinger Bands and ATR

- **Bands:** lower 106.10, middle 132.59, upper 159.08. The close of 103.03 is below the lower band.
- **Walking the lower band.** Four of the last five sessions closed at or below the lower band:

| Date | Close | Lower band |
|---|---:|---:|
| 11-10 | 121.07 | 121.18 |
| 11-12 | 114.41 | 115.60 |
| 11-13 | 111.62 | 111.68 |
| 11-16 | 103.03 | 106.10 |

  Only 11-11 was above it. The lower band itself has dropped from 137.77 (10-19) to 106.10, which is typical of a persistent downtrend. A close below the band is not by itself a reversal signal.
- **ATR** is 8.91, about 8.6% of price. It has eased from 10.01 on 11-05, so the selling has been steady rather than climactic on a range basis. Today's range (4.09 points) was well under ATR, while the gap-down open (103.74 vs the prior close of 111.62) did the damage.
- **Large moves in both directions are common.** Examples are +21.63 on 09-03, +21.67 on 09-18, -14.46 on 10-16 and -13.24 on 11-05. This matters for anyone positioned against the trend.

## 7. Reference levels (descriptive, not validated)

I did not verify any bounce or rejection history at these levels.

- **Overhead:**
  - 10 EMA at 120.54 (falling)
  - the 132.55–132.59 confluence
  - the 50 SMA at 142.47
- **Nearby:**
  - the lower band at 106.10 (now above price)
  - the 08-19 breakout close of 104.25, which price is sitting on
- **Below:**
  - the July–early August lows of 89.21–90.06 (07-13, 07-17, 07-24, 07-31)
  - the 06-26 closing low of 82.31, with an intraday low of 81.81

## 8. Actionable read

**Primary bias: bearish.** Price is below all four moving averages. The 10 EMA is below the 50 SMA. MACD is below zero and widening, and the sequence of lower highs and lower lows is intact. There is no trend-following long setup here.

**Scenarios to watch:**
1. **Continuation.** A close below today's low of 101.70 would open the way toward the 89–92 prior-low area. Rising volume on further declines would support this.
2. **Oversold bounce, which needs confirmation.** RSI is below 30 and price is below the lower band. Evidence I would want first:
   - RSI back above 30
   - a close back inside the lower band (above 106.10)
   - a higher low
   - a shrinking negative MACD histogram

   Even then, the first realistic hurdles are the 10 EMA (120.54, falling) and the ~132.6 confluence. A bounce into those levels would still sit inside a downtrend until the structure changes.
3. **Risk management.**
   - A stop of 1.5× ATR is about 13.4 points and 2× ATR is about 17.8.
   - Gap risk exceeds ATR often.
   - Shorts are exposed to sharp squeezes like the Aug and Sep rallies.
   - Longs are exposed to continued band-walking.
   - Size positions to the wider ATR-based stops, not to the one-day range.
